tools.name: enhance_media
tools.description: Clean speech in a video or audio file. Submit a public HTTPS URL or a completed upload, then poll get_job if it is still running. For a keyless upload, pass upload_id and omit anonymous_session. Keyless requests preview the first minute. Paid jobs may spend credits. Omit idempotency_key for normal u

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Read an existing job by job_id. For a keyless job, job_id is sufficient, so keep it private. Use the same API key for a keyed job. Optionally wait for a terminal state. A completed result includes the receipt and its download command.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Get a signed PUT for a local file. Upload exactly the declared byte count, then pass upload_id to enhance_media. For a keyless upload, upload_id is sufficient. Keep the ID and upload URL private.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read the credit balance, preview allowance and prices. With a pack and bearer key, return a checkout link for a person to open and approve payment.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Read the credit balance, preview allowance and prices. With a pack and bearer key, return a checkout link for a person to open and approve payment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: enhance_media, get_job, create_upload · Public sink: enhance_media, create_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_upload · Private data: enhance_media, get_job, create_upload · Public sink: enhance_media, create_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
